**How to choose:**

- **Baan Thai** and **Thai Orchid** are great if you want a full vegetarian menu with many vegan options.

All of these restaurants are located in the West Loop or Near North Side neighborhoods, which are easily accessible by public transit or car. Enjoy your meal!
